notes.title: Patient Care Protocols — Diabetes Management
notes.content:
Diabetes Patient Care Protocol — Study Notes
(Reviewing for David's care + professional development)

Type 2 Diabetes Management Protocol:

1. Assessment:
   - A1C every 3 months until at target, then every 6 months
   - Daily blood glucose monitoring (fasting + post-prandial)
   - Annual: eye exam, foot exam, kidney function, lipid panel
   - Weight monitoring

2. Medications:
   - First-line: Metformin (start 500mg BID, titrate to 2000mg)
   - If inadequate: Add sulfonylurea OR GLP-1 agonist OR SGLT2 inhibitor
   - If A1C >10% or symptoms: Consider insulin

3. Lifestyle modifications:
   - Medical nutrition therapy (carb counting, portion control)
   - Physical activity: 150 min/week moderate intensity
   - Weight loss goal: 5-7% of body weight
   - Smoking cessation (if applicable)

4. Monitoring targets:
   - A1C: <7% (individualized for elderly: <8%)
   - Fasting glucose: 80-130 mg/dL
   - Post-meal: <180 mg/dL
   - BP: <130/80

5. Complications screening:
   - Retinopathy (annual eye exam)
   - Nephropathy (annual urine albumin)
   - Neuropathy (annual foot exam)
   - Cardiovascular (lipids, BP)

For David: He's at A1C 7.8%, fasting 140-180 range. Still above target. If April check shows no improvement, Dr. Kim may add medication.
